reader.title: School letter: Grade 4 field trip to the Royal Ontario Museum, with a permission form
reader.issuer: Danforth Park Public School (M. Osei, Principal)
reader.what_it_is: A letter from your child's school about a class trip to the Royal Ontario Museum on Thursday, October 15, 2026. It includes a permission form for you to sign.
reader.what_it_asks: Sign the permission form and return it to your child's teacher with $12.00 by Friday, October 9, 2026. Cash or a cheque to the school is accepted, and the letter says no student is excluded if the cost is a difficulty. Your child should bring a packed lunch and wear comfortable shoes.

interpreter.target_text: Esta es una carta de la escuela de su hijo o hija sobre una excursión de la clase de 4.º grado (Grade 4) al Royal Ontario Museum el jueves 15 de octubre de 2026 (Thursday, October 15, 2026). Incluye un formulario de permiso para que usted lo firme. Le piden que firme el formulario y lo devuelva al maestro o maestra de su hijo con $12.00 antes del viernes 9 de octubre de 2026 (Friday, October 9, 2026). Aceptan efectivo o un cheque a nombre de la escuela, y la carta dice que ningún estudiante queda excluido si el costo es una dificultad. Su hijo debe llevar almuerzo y zapatos cómodos. Fechas: entregar el formulario firmado y el pago antes de: Friday, October 9, 2026; fecha de la excursión: Thursday, October 15, 2026. Cantidad: $12.00.
interpreter.back_translation: This is a letter from your child's school about a Grade 4 class trip to the Royal Ontario Museum on Thursday, October 15, 2026. It includes a permission form for you to sign. They ask you to sign the form and return it to your child's teacher with $12.00 by Friday, October 9, 2026. They accept cash or a cheque made out to the school, and the letter says no student is excluded if the cost is a difficulty. Your child should bring lunch and comfortable shoes. Dates: return the signed form and payment by: Friday, October 9, 2026; trip date: Thursday, October 15, 2026. Amount: $12.00.

flagged_terms.note: 'formulario de permiso'; the visitor signs it, they do not write a letter.

drafter.title: Completed permission form and short note to the teacher
drafter.body_en:
PERMISSION FORM
I give permission for my child, ____________________ (student name), in Class ______, to attend the Grade 4 trip to the Royal Ontario Museum on Thursday, October 15, 2026.
Emergency contact name: ____________________   Phone: 416-555-0199
Parent/Guardian signature: ____________________   Date: ____________

Note to the teacher: Enclosed is $12.00 in cash for the trip. My child has no allergies and no medical conditions.
drafter.body_target:
FORMULARIO DE PERMISO
Doy permiso para que mi hijo/a, ____________________ (nombre del estudiante), de la clase ______, asista a la excursión de 4.º grado al Royal Ontario Museum el jueves 15 de octubre de 2026.
Contacto de emergencia: ____________________   Teléfono: 416-555-0199
Firma del padre, madre o tutor: ____________________   Fecha: ____________

Nota para el maestro/a: Adjunto $12.00 en efectivo para la excursión. Mi hijo/a no tiene alergias ni condiciones médicas.
